items.title: ServiceNow stock: catalysts, technicals, and outlook after the selloff
items.summary: Investing.com -- ServiceNow Inc (NOW) trades at $92.19, up 5.23% on Nov 23 as of 3:48 PM EST. It is down about 43% over 1 month and 46% over 1 year, and it sits near the $81.24 52-week low (market cap about $95B). The damage came from one event. After the Oct 28 Q3 report, the stock posted its worst single-day drop on record, about 27–31% depending on the source. The headline numbers were fine: revenue was $4.11B, up 20.5%. items.title: Do credit card points expire? Rules by issuer, airline, and hotel program
